newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon to launch new personal use fax machine.
newsitem.headline: Canon to launch new personal use fax machine.

text.p: Canon Inc said on Monday that it would start selling the world's first personal use fax machine with a colour copying function in Japan on October 29.
There will be two models, priced at 73,000 yen and 88,000 yen, a company spokesman said. The company plans to make a total of 20,000 units per month, he said.

The new fax machines are installed with a colour scanner and can copy colour pages, the company said in a statement. They can also come with a cordless telephone at an additional cost of 20,000 yen, the statement said.
